item.title: Nvidia RTX 50 graphics card prices climb as TSMC and memory costs rise
item.summary: Nvidia GeForce RTX 50 series graphics card prices in South Korea were set to rise by as much as 30% starting in August 2026 as higher wafer costs at Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company and continued increases in GDDR7 memory prices pushed up supply-chain expenses. The increase was reported by Tom’s Hardware , citing South Korean media outlet ZDNet Korea and industry sources.
